# Published 0.5.2 Native SDK Archive upgrade

Four frozen Native@1 Runs come from the real npm 0.5.2 factory and SDK: pending Archive prepare, applied Specs with pending finalize, claimed finalize before the move, and an actual completed move whose original executor result was not yet recorded. User decisions and Agent acceptance text are explicitly simulated fixture inputs. The harmless Node check, Spec application, directory move and persisted receipt came from the published executors.

The Git bundle preserves the original branch and commit. Current tests materialize the original project bytes and restore the original Run through the public store API. They copy only existing Archive transactions and receipts; old process records, check caches, snapshots, indexes and projection markers are not loaded. The unreported result fixture retains the exact original claim and actual executor output. No model, Eval, push or remote delivery was run.

Provenance, original controllers, successful public CLI probes and retained failed attempts are documented in section 19 of `docs/research/2026-11-10-native-platform-execution-retirement.zh.md`.
